description: Look up a .cell name (for example alice.cell) on the Nervos blockchain and return where its owner is paid: a CKB address, and when published a Bitcoin address, an Ethereum/EVM address, a Lightning Address and a Fiber node. Also whether the name is registered, its state (live, grace or free) and when it expires. Read from the chain directly, and only addresses written by whoever holds the name now are returned (one a former owner left is listed as withheld). Pay with your own wallet to the address returned; never to an address taken from anywhere else.

network.description: Which Nervos network to read. Defaults to mainnet.

name: resolve_cell_name
title: Where a .cell name is paid
